title: Relabeling an oracle machine's states
statement: Given an oracle Turing machine with state set $S$ and an equivalence $e:S\simeq S'$, define the machine over state set $S'$ by applying $e$ to its initial, query, positive-answer, and negative-answer states. Its transition at state $q'$, scanned input symbol, and scanned work-tape symbols is the original transition at $e^{-1}(q')$, with each successor state relabeled by $e$.
